description.value:
This extension applies to the Medication, MedicationRequest, MedicationDispense and MedicationStatement resources and is used to represent the generic drug name of a medication, typically based on the name of its active ingredient(s). The generic drug name may not be the same as the subject medication (prescribed, dispensed or stated) but may be used to provide an additional non-proprietary drug name. This extension is not to be the sole representation of the medication concept; it shall not be used as a substitute for medication code (e.g. Medication.code or MedicationStatement.medicationCodeableConcept).
If a system can only supply generic drug name information, and only in text form, that information will be supplied in the text portion of that code e.g. code.text or medicationCodeableConcept.text. This extension only supports providing a generic drug name as additional text information, not as a coded medication concept, and does not represent the proprietary (brand) name. It is available for use where a system needs to separate out the generic drug name string for handling or other processing.

definition.value: The generic drug name for an associated medication, typically based on the name of its active ingredient(s). This may differ from the medication identified in the code (e.g. where the code identifies a branded product) and may be used to provide an additional non-proprietary drug name.
